As mean throughout all of Night City as it is on the streets of Santo. In other words, it's going to be a mess.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Long Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Vivisector • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Hyper Expansive Ammunition. When firing Shells with this weapon and incurring a Critical Injury, the user may roll twice on the Critical Injury table and choose one result for the victim to suffer [Vivisector]. If this weapon caused a Dismemberment Critical Injury in the previous Round of combat, then when now rolling for damage, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user’s Move Action as long as they are holding it in two hands.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Long Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Vivisector (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
